nodes.summary: For an integer $T\ge0$, a triple $(a,b,c)\in\mathbb Z^3$ is a false triple in the box if $|a|,|b|,|c|\le T$ and $ab\ne c$. For such a triple write the fifteen coordinates of $(\iota(a),\iota(b),\iota(c))$, in point-major order, as reduced fractions $A_j/B_j$ with $B_j>0$ ($j=1,\dots,15$), and put $D_{abc}=\prod_{j=1}^{15}B_j$. nodes.summary: Every $u\in K_0$ has a unique normalized representation $u=(a+bs)/c$ with $a,b,c\in\mathbb Z$, $c>0$ and $\gcd(a,b,c)=1$ (for $u=0$ this is $(0,0,1)$). For a point $Q$ of $E(K_0)$ put $\xi(Q)=1/x(Q)$ if $Q\ne O$ and $x(Q)\ne0$, and $\xi(Q)=0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: The least formal multiple

nodes.summary: Let $W\ge1$, $k\ge0$ and $B\ge0$ be integers. For each residue $r$ with $1\le r<W$ and $\gcd(r,W)=1$, let $p_{r,1}<p_{r,2}<\dots<p_{r,k}$ be the first $k$ primes $p$ with $p>B$ and $p\equiv r\pmod W$. Define \mathrm{catalogue\_max}(W,k,B)=\max_{r,j}p_{r,j},$$ with the maximum of an empty family equal to $0$. The fixed catalogue of the manuscript is $W=4\prod_{p\le324}p$, $k=22$, $B=324$: the first twenty-two primes…

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
